scope: Explicit premises and evaluation gates for the displayed polarity and single-cell action/clock targets. Completeness is by target declaration, not the full 448-row research ledger. Edition 0.4 adds the finite response-source refinement; no native response law is supplied.
propagation_policy: Hypothetical premise-change drill. Descendants are PENDING_REDERIVATION for reuse; stored scientific statuses are unchanged. Conditional theorem statements retain their explicitly declared premises.

nodes.title: Typed pair variables
nodes.conclusion: q=1−Theta; omega=T AND L. These binary response and viability masks are different objects.

nodes.title: Admissible response domain
nodes.conclusion: omega ≤ q ≤ T coordinatewise; five admissible triples per address.

nodes.title: Idle-response decomposition
nodes.conclusion: h is binary, nonnegative and supported on intact-null addresses; q=omega+h with disjoint support.

nodes.title: Finite continuation spaces
nodes.conclusion: Declare finite spaces with dimensions |omega−| and |omega+|. No causal source is inferred from their dimensions.

nodes.title: Rank-nullity index
nodes.conclusion: ind Fomega=|omega−|−|omega+| for any linear map on the declared spaces. The rank cancels.

nodes.title: Full Hamming budget
nodes.conclusion: muTheta=|Theta+|−|Theta−|=|q−|−|q+|. Cardinalities are invariant under pair-frame permutations.

nodes.title: Idle-corrected identity
nodes.conclusion: muTheta=ind Fomega+|h−|−|h+|. This is an identity on ordered admissible states, not an endpoint predictor.

nodes.title: Index equals full budget iff idle totals match
nodes.conclusion: muTheta=ind Fomega iff |h−|=|h+|. Equal idle totals need not mean either mask is zero.

nodes.title: Saturated prior premise
nodes.conclusion: This is an additional premise for the saturated-prior corollary, not a consequence of rank-nullity.

nodes.title: Saturated-prior corollary
nodes.conclusion: With h−=0, index-only equality holds iff h+=0. Using that equality to prove no-idle response is circular.

nodes.title: POC-1 no-idle response
nodes.conclusion: A candidate constitutive law needing an independent source; it is not proved by demanding index-only equality.

nodes.title: Binding no-idle address
nodes.conclusion: If POC-1 binds the response, the final address is fixed. A competing burden minimizer cannot freely choose a different final address.

nodes.title: Burden and integrity inputs
nodes.conclusion: A supplied burden selector optimizes a target Hamming shell subject to integrity; it must also respect the chosen viability/idle-response contract.

nodes.title: Conditional shell optimizer
nodes.objects: argmin on a declared finite shell
nodes.conclusion: An empty admissible shell returns infeasible; a tied optimum holds unresolved symmetry. The historical integrity-only shell is not automatically compatible with binding POC-1.

nodes.title: Two final selectors can conflict
nodes.conclusion: POC-1 gives Theta=011 (cost 18); integrity-only k=2 minimization gives 110 (cost 10), violating omega≤q. Adding viability fixes this example.

nodes.title: Frame-alignment receipt
nodes.objects: Oriented C1 transport; old Theta and omega
nodes.conclusion: A native address prediction requires an independently obtained relative-frame receipt and aligned prior address masks. Count identities alone do not provide this receipt.

nodes.title: Native pre-event viability source
nodes.conclusion: Finite rank-nullity does not construct independently sourced obligation spaces from native evolution.

nodes.title: Independent idle-response source
nodes.conclusion: Supply typed gate dynamics, an independent silence theorem, an authenticated pre-event receipt or blinded response discrimination. Endpoint-inferred h is forbidden.

nodes.title: Native address/polarity prediction
nodes.conclusion: A predictive model needs independently generated viable and idle response data, the address-frame receipt, and a consistent final selector. Exact endpoint identities do not close these gates.

nodes.title: Eligible independent score
nodes.conclusion: No new empirical score is issued by this graph. Original scorer custody, source admission and eligible target-hidden episodes remain required.

nodes.title: Fixed-K flux witness
nodes.conclusion: Unchanged viable obligation gives zero index/budget; edge support rises by 3/8 (one pair 1/8).

nodes.title: Universal flux-index equality fails
nodes.objects: signed support diagnostic versus integer index
nodes.conclusion: The witness disproves universal equality on this admitted domain. A diagnostic under a new restricted contract remains a separate possibility.

nodes.title: Typed action unit
nodes.objects: B0 masslike; a0 length; tau0 time
nodes.conclusion: A0=B0 a0²/tau0 has action dimensions. This definition supplies no measured value.

nodes.title: Unit chain metric and active sector
nodes.conclusion: Fix the declared unit metric and active nonharmonic sector. Changing this carrier or metric requires rederiving its generator and action geometry.

nodes.title: Single-cell spectral identity
nodes.conclusion: The active frequency is 2 in native parameter s; the harmonic component is static. This source-supplied finite identity is not independently reproofed here.

nodes.title: Active complex structure
nodes.conclusion: The active restriction is an orthogonal complex structure; the induced symplectic convention is fixed by this norm.

nodes.title: Lifted phase history
nodes.conclusion: Retain winding in lifted phase, with phase rate 2 in native parameter. Endpoint phase modulo 2pi discards this history.

nodes.title: Single-sector lifted action
nodes.conclusion: With the declared symplectic normalization, accumulated native action is S=A0(a/2)Delta phi tilde. It varies continuously with support a.

nodes.title: Specific action-phase scale
nodes.conclusion: For a>0 and nonzero lifted phase, the ratio is independent of amplitude. It is not yet physical hbar.

nodes.title: Normalized representative
nodes.objects: a=1 on an explicitly normalized ray
nodes.conclusion: Normalizing a representative does not prove native support quantization or physical quantum identity.

nodes.title: Normalized recurrence action
nodes.conclusion: One single-cell recurrence has native interval pi; its normalized circulation is pi A0. This is not a universal glued-carrier recurrence.

nodes.title: Endpoint versus history comparison
nodes.objects: Same endpoint: zero winding and one winding
nodes.conclusion: Admit both a zero-duration history and a nonzero full-cycle active orbit at the same endpoint with a>0.

nodes.title: Endpoint-only accumulated action no-go
nodes.objects: Endpoint defect delta(U) versus lifted action
nodes.conclusion: Zero winding has action 0; one full active winding has pi a A0 at the same endpoint. An endpoint-only scalar cannot encode both.

nodes.title: Universal scalar alias retired
nodes.conclusion: The ledger retires a universal scalar alias. A restricted alias needs a new sufficiency/proportionality and carrier-stability certificate.

nodes.title: Conditional scalar-family algebra
nodes.objects: Supplied scalar on a declared operator family
nodes.conclusion: Retiring a universal native alias does not invalidate algebra conditional on a supplied scalar. No specific scalar-family operator is reproofed in this graph.

nodes.title: Restricted scalar sufficiency certificate
nodes.conclusion: A declared compression must retain O09 history and have carrier-stable proportionality before any restricted native scalar identification.

nodes.title: Restricted native scalar identification
nodes.conclusion: This conditional reopening route needs both valid scalar-family algebra and the separate sufficiency certificate. It does not revive the universal alias.

nodes.title: Unambiguous current ratio
nodes.conclusion: Current ratio direction is A0/hbar. Historical bare xi_hbar used reciprocal conventions and must remain typed.

nodes.title: QPB-1 physical correspondence candidate
nodes.conclusion: Identifying the specific native action-phase scale with physical hbar is a candidate correspondence, not a theorem from internal geometry.

nodes.title: Independent physical A0 anchor
nodes.conclusion: Freeze an independently constructed action anchor excluding hbar, h, Planck units, known action targets and fitting to 2. No such data is supplied here.

nodes.title: Prospective QPB-1 comparison
nodes.conclusion: Only after freezing the independent anchor compare with 2 under source-derived uncertainty; PASS, FAIL, indeterminate and invalid-source are distinct verdicts.

nodes.title: Speed/action identities
nodes.conclusion: Even fixed A0 and c_speed determine B0 tau0, not B0 and tau0 separately.

nodes.title: Physical clock scale gauge
nodes.conclusion: (a0,tau0,B0)→(lambda a0,lambda tau0,B0/lambda) fixes speed and action, while physical frequency scales as 1/lambda and G_SI as lambda².

nodes.title: Action anchor alone cannot set seconds
nodes.conclusion: An independent action anchor can test eta_A but is invariant under the residual clock gauge. It cannot alone identify absolute tau0. This is an explicit algebraic consequence of E11.

citations.anchor_text: What can break the scale gauge?

nodes.title: Independent scale-sensitive anchor
nodes.objects: Identified mass, length or time observable
nodes.conclusion: Supply a lawful physical observable that changes under lambda, an independently identified carrier and a unique map to native units. Merely supplying A0 or a dimensionless ratio is insufficient.

citations.anchor_text: What can break the scale gauge?

nodes.title: Absolute physical clock
nodes.conclusion: Absolute seconds require a source-complete, scale-sensitive physical correspondence. Native period pi or event coordinate 3/4 is not that anchor.

nodes.title: Same local canonical history
nodes.objects: Genesis and Hodge active local plane
nodes.conclusion: Assume the typed GH-1 balanced coordinate map represents the same local canonical history. c_bridge is a coordinate normalization, distinct from c_speed.

nodes.title: Stationary Genesis local carrier
nodes.conclusion: Use a locally stationary harmonic Genesis mode and its declared historical action/time units hbar_d,tau_d; neither is identified with physical hbar or seconds.

nodes.title: GH-2 active event geometry
nodes.conclusion: The active event length is a typed source object, not an independently fixed physical length.

nodes.title: Conditional Genesis–Hodge ratios
nodes.conclusion: The product is 3/(2delta_H²). Local harmonic action areas and recurrence periods match under the same-history canonical intertwiner. No absolute units follow.

nodes.title: Nonstationary history domain
nodes.conclusion: The no-go is conditional on a history with varying local frequency; it does not assert every Genesis history is nonstationary.

nodes.title: Constant unit-ratio requirement
nodes.objects: One constant tau0/tau_d across the whole history
nodes.conclusion: A proposed global identification uses one constant ratio rather than a newly supplied varying clock law.

nodes.title: Nonstationary global clock no-go
nodes.conclusion: One constant tau0/tau_d cannot equal 2/omega_G(t) at all times if the historical frequency varies. A new stationary/effective-clock theorem would be needed.

nodes.title: Intact-null potential domain
nodes.conclusion: I marks potential idle response addresses; h is the actual response. Prospective T,L must be independently sourced.

citations.anchor_text: I is the intact-null potential mask

nodes.title: Exact response fiber
nodes.conclusion: Every admitted response corresponds to one subset of I. There are exactly 2^i responses.

nodes.title: Count-conditioned address fiber
nodes.conclusion: An independently sourced idle count fixes a budget but generally leaves binomial(i,j) address masks.

nodes.title: Reduced equivariant rule domain
nodes.conclusion: These symmetry conclusions apply to a rule with no additional distinguishing pre-event state. Extra burdens, memory or source receipts require a larger declared carrier.

nodes.title: Reduced deterministic selector restriction
nodes.conclusion: For a deterministic equivariant selector based only on (T,L), the intact-null stabilizer forces a constant mask. Intermediate j cannot be selected for i≥2.

nodes.title: Invariant stochastic response kernels
nodes.conclusion: Invariant kernels have i+1 cardinality-orbit weights summing to 1. Symmetry leaves i free probability parameters. It does not set an event rate.

nodes.title: Admission does not select a response law
nodes.conclusion: Two admitted equivariant responses share the same reduced (T,L) but have budgets differing by i. This is finite-domain underidentification, not a physical realization claim.

nodes.title: Source-complete prospective packet
nodes.objects: Independent prospective viability, idle choice, frame and event/null program
nodes.conclusion: The contract narrows the missing source objects and supplies a structural validator. It does not generate a native packet or establish eligible scorer custody.
